name: Menu
summary: A list of selectable options — a side nav, a settings list, an overflow menu — with icons, groups, submenus and danger actions.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-menu> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Feed it an `items` tree and a `value` (the selected key). The DS V3 Menu is a family, not a flat list: rows carry leading icons, a group title splits sections, a divider rules them off, a submenu expands inline, an item can be disabled or a red danger action. Three `mode`s: `vertical` (compact popover list, default), `inline` (indented sidebar tree), `horizontal` (top nav bar). The selected row is brand-tinted; hover, selection, submenu expand and the caret all animate via the shared motion tokens on PERSISTENT nodes — a class toggles, the subtree is never rebuilt on a state change. Emits a composed `select`.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `select`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

opinion.note: One selection at a time — reserve the brand tint for the active row. Keep labels short and in sentence case. Group related rows under a title; rule off a destructive action with a divider and mark it danger. For a triggered overlay, put a Menu inside a Dropdown rather than reinventing the list.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Menu component-set taxonomy: Menu / Submenu/Inline, Menu Item / Inline / Group Title, / Inline / Navigation Item, / Horizontal menu, / Sidebar menu / Highest level, / Vertical / Popover Menu — i.e. the family carries modes (horizontal · inline/sidebar · vertical popover), group titles, submenus, navigation items, disabled + danger rows. Token layer: white surface, border #E3E3E3, bg-accent selected fill, color-primary label, color-error danger, text-tertiary group title, radius-default 8. Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes.
